identityScope: Four existing catalog rows in the outdoor category that previously had no field review were reviewed against current Aiper product pages. Scuba X1 Pro Max, Scuba V3, Scuba X1 and Scuba E1 are four separate models with their own pages. No new model was created and no Aiper company focus review exists. The Scuba X1 Pro Max page publishes 8,500 GPH suction, 9 brushless motors, 40 sensors, up to 300 minutes floor cleaning and up to 600 minutes skimming runtime, 4 hours wireless charging and IPX8 waterproofing, but no price, weight or dimensions; the catalog 2299 USD price and small size label are cleared. The Scuba V3 page publishes 4,800 GPH suction, VisionPath navigation with AI vision and dToF (20+ debris types, 2 m range, dual LEDs), JetAssist waterline cleaning, and 18.1 lbs (8.2 kg) weight, but no price, dimensions, battery runtime in minutes or charging time; the catalog 1199 USD price and small size label are cleared, and weight is updated from 7.5 kg to 18.1 lbs (8.2 kg). The Scuba X1 page publishes 6,600 GPH suction, 4 brushless motors, 14 sensors, WavePath navigation, up to 180 minutes runtime, 4 hours charging and IPX8 waterproofing, but no price, weight or dimensions; the catalog 1499 USD price and medium size label are cleared. The Scuba E1 page publishes 3,600 GPH suction, a tri-motor system (2 drive, 1 pump), 180 um + 3 um dual filtration, up to 100 minutes runtime and 3 hours charging for flat above-ground pools up to 1,100 sq.ft, but no price, weight or dimensions; the catalog ~599 USD price and medium size label are cleared. Aipers Euromonitor sales claim is not accepted as independent verification of market leadership. No reviewed page publishes payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate or terrain.

fields.description: The Aiper Scuba V3 is a cognitive AI-powered essential robotic pool cleaner for in-ground pools, featuring 4,800 GPH suction with dual brushes, MicroMesh multi-layer filtration, and a featherlight design weighing 18.1 lbs (8.2 kg). It utilizes VisionPath route planning combining AI vision and dToF obstacle avoidance (recognizing 20+ debris types with 2 m range and dual LEDs for night cleaning), JetAssist horizontal waterline cleaning, an AI Navium hands-free cleaning plan, and a compact wireless charging dock. The page publishes no price, robot dimensions, battery life in minutes, charging time, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate or terrain; the catalog 1199 USD price and small size label are cleared, and the 7.5 kg weight is updated to 18.1 lbs (8.2 kg).

fields.description: The Aiper Scuba E1 is an above-ground robotic pool cleaner for flat pool floors up to 1,100 sq.ft (100 m2) and 33 ft (10 m) in length, featuring a tri-motor system (2 drive, 1 pump) with 3,600 GPH (13,600 LPH) suction and flow rate, a bottom roller brush, and dual-layer filtration (180 um fine filter basket + 3 um ultra-fine filter) with a 3.6 L top-load capacity. The page publishes no price, robot weight, robot dimensions, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate or terrain; the catalog ~599 USD price and medium size label are cleared.
